params.sql: SELECT product_id,name,unit,pack_multiplier FROM products WHERE product_id='PRD-001'
SELECT p.product_id,o.organization_id,o.name,o.role_code FROM products p JOIN organizations o ON p.supplier_id=o.organization_id WHERE p.product_id='PRD-002'
SELECT l.location_id,l.name,l.location_type_code,o.organization_id,o.name AS organization_name FROM locations l JOIN organizations o USING(organization_id) WHERE location_id='WH-001'
SELECT l.location_id,l.name,o.organization_id,o.name AS organization_name FROM locations l JOIN organizations o USING(organization_id) WHERE location_id='STORE-002'
SELECT lot_id,product_id,produced_date,expiry_date FROM lots WHERE lot_id='LOT-003-A'
SELECT product_id,min_shelf_days,unit FROM products WHERE product_id='PRD-004'
SELECT product_id,unit,3*CAST(pack_multiplier AS NUMERIC) AS base_quantity FROM products WHERE product_id IN ('PRD-001','PRD-002','PRD-003')
SELECT l.lot_id,l.product_id,o.name AS supplier_name,l.expiry_date FROM lots l JOIN organizations o ON l.supplier_id=o.organization_id WHERE l.product_id='PRD-005'

SELECT o.organization_id,o.name,COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM organizations o LEFT JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id=o.organization_id WHERE o.role_code='supplier' GROUP BY o.organization_id,o.name

SELECT l.lot_id,l.product_id,l.supplier_id,p.supplier_id AS product_supplier_id,o.role_code FROM lots l LEFT JOIN products p USING(product_id) LEFT JOIN organizations o ON l.supplier_id=o.organization_id WHERE p.product_id IS NULL OR o.organization_id IS NULL OR o.role_code!='supplier'

SELECT movement_id,event_id,event_date,destination_location_id,quantity,unit FROM movements WHERE lot_id='LOT-001-A' AND event_type_code='receive' AND view_code='actual' AND event_date<='2027-02-28' AND recorded_date<='2027-02-28'
SELECT inspection_id,lot_id,inspection_date,result_code,reason FROM inspections WHERE lot_id='LOT-002-A' AND known_date<='2027-02-28' AND inspection_date<='2027-02-28'

SELECT h.hold_id,h.lot_id,h.location_id,h.quantity,h.reason FROM holds h JOIN lots l USING(lot_id) WHERE l.product_id='PRD-004' AND h.effective_from<='2027-02-28' AND h.effective_to>='2027-02-28' AND h.known_date<='2027-02-28'

SELECT inspection_id,lot_id,location_id,inspection_date,known_date,result_code FROM inspections WHERE lot_id='LOT-007-A' AND inspection_date<='2027-02-28' AND known_date<='2027-02-28' ORDER BY inspection_date DESC,inspection_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT x.link_id,x.parent_lot_id,x.child_lot_id,x.link_type_code,x.parent_quantity,x.child_quantity,x.unit FROM lot_links x JOIN lots l ON x.parent_lot_id=l.lot_id WHERE l.product_id='PRD-003' AND x.effective_date<='2027-02-28' AND x.known_date<='2027-02-28'

SELECT event_id,event_type_code,source_location_id,destination_location_id,event_date,event_sequence,quantity,unit FROM movements WHERE lot_id='LOT-007-B' AND event_date<='2027-02-28' AND recorded_date<='2027-02-28' AND view_code='actual' ORDER BY event_date,CAST(event_sequence AS NUMERIC),event_id
SELECT p.product_id,p.min_shelf_days,l.lot_id,l.expiry_date FROM products p JOIN lots l USING(product_id) WHERE p.product_id='PRD-012'

SELECT l.line_id,l.order_id,l.product_id,l.quantity,l.unit,l.min_shelf_days,o.due_date,o.priority FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_id='ORD-001-A' AND o.status_code='open'

SELECT r.reservation_id,r.line_id,r.lot_id,r.location_id,r.quantity FROM reservations r JOIN order_lines l USING(line_id) WHERE l.order_id='ORD-002-A' AND r.effective_from<='2027-02-28' AND r.effective_to>='2027-02-28' AND r.known_date<='2027-02-28'

SELECT forecast_id,product_id,location_id,demand_date,quantity,unit,known_date FROM demand_forecasts WHERE product_id='PRD-001' AND demand_date>'2027-02-28' AND demand_date<='2027-03-31' AND known_date<='2027-02-28' AND view_code='planned'

SELECT m.event_id,m.lot_id,m.destination_location_id,m.event_date,m.quantity,m.unit FROM movements m JOIN lots l USING(lot_id) WHERE l.product_id='PRD-002' AND m.view_code='planned' AND m.event_type_code IN ('receive','produce') AND m.recorded_date<='2027-02-28' AND m.event_date>'2027-02-28' AND m.event_date<='2027-03-31'
SELECT recall_id,root_lot_id,announced_date,reason,status_code FROM recalls WHERE recall_id='REC-001'
